name: Hellfire
bio: The Warden of the Inferno and director of the Royal Military Prison. Taunts enemies into attacking her and deals damage that scales off her own Max HP — a self-sustaining frontline.

skills.name: Cage of Despair
skills.desc: Deals Pyro Damage to surrounding enemies and taunts them.

skills.name: Retributive Resolve
skills.desc: Increases Max HP and continuously restores HP.

skills.name: Guilty Verdict
skills.desc: Increases damage dealt to enemies taunted by Hellfire.

skills.name: Aetherflame
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby Pyro teammate(s).
